questions.question: Which description fits the **CodeSystem** resource?
options: This resource is used to declare the existence of and describe a code system or code system supplement and its key properties, and optionally define a part or all of its content.
This resource documents a set of capabilities (behaviors) of a FHIR Terminology Server that may be used as a statement of actual server functionality or a statement of required or desired server…
A curated namespace that issues unique symbols within that namespace for the identification of concepts, people, devices, etc.
A statement of relationships from one set of concepts to one or more other concepts - either concepts in code systems, or data element/data element concepts, or classes in class models.
questions.explanation: **CodeSystem**: The CodeSystem resource is used to declare the existence of and describe a code system or code system supplement and its key properties, and optionally define a part or all of its content. The other descriptions belong to **TerminologyCapabilities**, **NamingSystem**, **ConceptMap**.

questions.question: Which resource would you use? Define a set of codes and what each one means.
questions.explanation: **CodeSystem**. Defines codes. A ValueSet selects from code systems.

questions.question: You know **CodeSystem**. Which resource should you use instead when you need “selects codes for a use”?
questions.explanation: **ValueSet**: selects codes for a use. **CodeSystem** is for something else: The CodeSystem resource is used to declare the existence of and describe a code system or code system supplement and its key properties, and optionally define a part or all of its content.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **CodeSystem** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of CodeSystem are `status` (1..1), `content` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.

questions.question: Which element of **CodeSystem** is a **modifier** (?!), so receiving systems must not ignore it?
questions.explanation: Modifier elements of CodeSystem: `status`. `status`: draft | active | retired | unknown. A modifier can change the meaning of the whole resource: for example, a status of `entered-in-error` means the data must not be used.
